paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante thu pia inla, a kiang uah, Ka ann kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang ah thillat pen a hun geih zel chiah na lan ding uhi, chi in.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘My offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall observe to offer to me in their due season.’

paite: Huan, a kiang uah, Hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi; belamnou a pa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, ni teng in nih, halmang thillat lan gige ding in.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, khat nitaklam in na lan ding uh:
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;

paite: Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte epha mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
english: with the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

paite: TOUPA ding a mai a thillat, gimlim ding a sinai tang a sehsa halmang a thillat lat gige ding chih ahi.
english: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, belamnou khat latna a dawn ding thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi: TOUPA ding a uain, dawn ding thillat mun siangthou ah na bungkhe ding ahi.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

paite: Huan, belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan ding hi: zingsang lam in tangbuang thillat bang leh huai a dawn ding thillat bangbang TOUPA ding a gimlim di'n mei a thillat na lat ding ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening: as the meal offering of the morning, and as the drink offering of it, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, khawlni in belamnou, a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte epha mun sawm a khen a mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh huai a dawn ding thillat toh na lat ding ahi;
english: “‘On the Sabbath day two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and the drink offering of it:

paite: Hiai khawlni teng a halmang a thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim louh a halmanga thillat lat ding ahi.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Huan, na kha thak teng un TOUPA ding halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih leh belamtal khat leh belamnou a pa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih;
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Huan, bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm epha mun sawm a khen a mun thum; huan, belam khat ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen a mun nih;
english: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

paite: Huan, belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen a mun khat: hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, a dawn ding thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi ding a belamtal khat ah hin mun thum a khen a mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen a mun khat: hiai kumtawn a kha teng halmang thillat ahi.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

paite: Huan, TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia keltal khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang a thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
english: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Huan, kha khat na, ni sawm leh ni li ni TOUPA paikan ahi.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huan, huai kha ni sawm leh ni nga ni annkuanglui ni ahi ding; ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

paite: Ni khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a om ding a: bang nna mahmah na sep ding uh ahi kei;
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work;

paite: Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih leh belamtal khat leh belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sagih: na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi:
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

paite: Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, a tangbuang thillat utoh: bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih:
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: you shall offer three tenth parts for a bull, and two tenth parts for the ram.

paite: Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat ahi ding ahi;
english: You shall offer a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Huan nou a ding a kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

paite: Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a dawn ding thillat sim lou in
english: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Hichibangin Toupa' dinga gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding ni tengin, ni sagih na lat ding uh ahi: halmang thilat lat gige leh huai dawn ding thillat sim lou in.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Huan, a ni sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh hilou ahi.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work.

paite: Huan, na nipikal annkuang luina na buh thak tung annkuang luina TOUPA ding a thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei;
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work;

paite: TOUPA ding a gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; bawngtal tung nih, belamtal khat, belamnou a pa kum khat a upa sagih;
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

paite: A tangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun thum.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for each bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

paite: Belamtal khat ah mun sawm a khen a mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen a mun khat;
english: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding keltal khat toh.Halmang thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite na lat ding uh ahi (na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi), dawn ding thillat toh.
english: one male goat, to make atonement for you.

paite: Halmang thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite na lat ding uh ahi (na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi), dawn ding thillat toh.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, you shall offer them (they shall be to you without blemish), and their drink offerings.
